messages:
Aisha: quick design review — playground schema editor + function defs + run history. spotted a11y and copy nits we should decide on before the next build. @Ben @Carlos
Ben: thanks — can you list the top 3 things?
Aisha: sure. 1) Schema editor: the required/optional badge contrast is low, fails AA for small text. 2) Function def panel: 'Test' button label is ambiguous — maybe 'Run with sample input'. 3) Run history: we show only duration, not token delta; PMs want cost estimate.
Carlos: +1 on contrast. For badge colors we should use darker border + remap to our tokens. I can push a quick token-swatch in the styleguide.
Dana: on the button copy — "Run with sample input" is long, how about "Run sample"? shorter and still clear?
Aisha: I prefer clarity over brevity for first-time users. "Run sample input"? also we should surface keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter) next to button.
Ben: accessibility: keyboard focus outline in the editor is currently removed by vscode-esque styles. we should restore a visible focus ring for all interactive items.
DesignBot: accessibility check: schema editor badges low contrast (AA fail), focusable elements missing aria-labels: add aria-labels to badge toggles and function param rows.
Carlos: for function defs, suggestion: flatten advanced options into a collapsible "Settings" rather than full panel — reduces visual weight.
Aisha: agree. Also UX for function param typing: show small example payload inline under param name, e.g., `email: string — example: "user@example.com"`. keeps copy/usage in one place.
Dana: run history: request filtering by model, schema-run vs ad-hoc, and ability to pin a run as canonical example. Also show token delta + estimated $ in tiny muted text.
Ben: how accurate should cost estimate be? rough ballpark is okay but show disclaimer. maybe use 3-tier estimate (low/median/high).
Aisha: yep — low/median/high with tooltip explaining assumptions. also add a "compare runs" checkbox in the history list for side-by-side diffs of inputs/outputs.
Carlos: technical: diff output should highlight structured output fields that changed, not just token diffs. we can reuse our eval diff util.
Dana: small copy nit across the console: use sentence case for button labels ("Run sample input", not "RUN Sample Input"). consistent with our platform.
Aisha: final ask: I'll compile these into a tiny spec for eng + accessibility with screenshots. @Ben can you own the focus outlines + keyboard shortcuts? @Carlos can you prototype badge color swatches and param-examples? @Dana can you update button copy and run-history mock?
Ben: can do, aim to have PR by EOD Friday.
Carlos: prototyping today, will drop Figma link in this thread when ready.
Dana: will mock run-history changes tomorrow.
Aisha: thanks all :thumbsup: — attaching quick screens in Figma will help perf reviews.
